heading: Oral surgery: questions.
items: Dr. Esam Nahlah, the specialist who also restores the tooth afterwards, so nothing is lost in a handover.
Is bone grafting always needed for an implant?
No. Grafting is needed where bone has been lost after a missing tooth; it is placed, sutured and left a few months to integrate before the implant goes in.
Can I have sedation for oral surgery?
Yes: nitrous oxide or oral sedation. Oral sedation has to be planned ahead, so ask for it at the consultation rather than on the day.
Can I leave with a temporary tooth the same day?
Qualifying patients do: CT-guided implant placement makes it precise, and a temporary can go in the same day.
How do I book oral surgery in McLean or Alexandria?
Through either office: Tysons Corner in McLean on (703) 448-3312, or Duke Street in Alexandria on (571) 617-7245. The whole sequence is explained before any of it starts.
